authorization_semantics.initiation_event: successful zerone-2 commit of the exact pre-signed history-link transaction bytes and expected transaction hash
authorization_semantics.if_not_initiated_by_deadline: authorization lapses; keep every public service absent, do not change DNS, and issue a new decision and transaction if still appropriate
authorization_semantics.after_initiation: only exact public-profile deployments, endpoint and DNS publication, final evidence publication, and bounded beta monitoring remain authorized while the signed preconditions remain satisfiable

scope_if_go: broadcast only the exact pre-signed zerone-2 history-link transaction before the initiation deadline
after its successful commit, deploy exact public zerone-2 edge and query-gateway configs
after its successful commit, deploy exact public zerone-1 archive query-gateway config against the already-private archive origin
publish exact public P2P and query coordinates and apply the reviewed DNS change manifest
publish final checkpoint, signatures, evidence hashes, registration receipts, and postmortem
monitor the initial public beta continuously
required_preconditions: old zerone-1 signer remains fenced and cannot restart
archive adoption authority and final checkpoint signatures verify under the release-authorized transition fingerprint
FINAL binds exact passing A/E custom-staking census report bytes; separately, independently verified release-built census binary provenance must exist
private archive A/A readiness evidence remains byte-stable
private zerone-2 health and protocol-dark invariants were freshly revalidated
all three public config mappings equal the immutable release packet
public notice hash and endpoint coordinates are consistent
initial_beta_exclusions: direct plaintext RPC or REST origins
custom-staking census as migration or validator authority
bridge, claims, automatic issuance, knowledge rewards, alignment, counterexamples, or liquidity activation
